{"notes": "Visit 1 (1:15): Plan was a left-facing fish. Strokes were top body (Leo), bottom body (Maya), tail fin (Tom), with Priya checking joins. I can't tell who placed which domino, so I'm rating only what I saw and heard.

Visit 2 (2:00). Table: the top line is now fully connected from the start around to the tail, ending in a ROUNDED loop (x~21-24.5), not the pad's pointed fin. The bottom line is connected to x~12.3, up from 8.6, but still about 9 units short of the tail. No pale pieces are visible and no fin has been started that I could see. Priya's hands were at the tail.

LEO: Reached the tail point with the top line, so execution is strong. He spotted the rounded-tail mismatch and kept the group informed. At 1:45 he told Tom to help Maya and Priya to check the join, which is good delegation. He also took the fin on himself, which is a drift toward doing everything. Watch whether the fin actually appears.

MAYA: Said nothing this visit. Her bottom line grew about 3.7 units, which is steady but slow. Leo and Priya both called it slow. Ask whether she needs help and whether she'll meet the tail.

TOM: Privately said he is redoing the tail from the pad, and that matches the plan. I haven't seen him build anything and no fin exists yet. Leo then reassigned him. Still no evidence of output, so no rating basis. Ask what he is doing now.

PRIYA: Privately said she is redoing the tail herself, which is proactive and her hands were at the tail. But Tom, Leo and Priya each said they were redoing it, so there is a coordination risk of duplicated work. Her honest read of the status was accurate.

Next: check that one person owns the fin, that the bottom line meets it, and that the rounded loop is fixed."}
